university.name: Middlesex University
university.summary: A university with its main address in Hendon, London, which describes campuses in London, Dubai and Mauritius. It publishes a Pakistan page covering undergraduate and postgraduate entry, a regional award for Pakistani nationals and a regional representative contact.
university.eligibility_note: Listed on the gov.uk register of licensed student sponsors (Student route, Higher Education Institution, no action plan flag), register dated 2026-09-18

courses.title: Digital Marketing
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, 2 years part-time, 12 months placement option listed
courses.overview: A taught master's in digital marketing delivered at the Hendon campus through blended online and face-to-face teaching, with a capstone research project and an optional 12 month professional placement.
highlights: Global Marketing Management and Digital Strategy
Capstone Research Project (all listed as compulsory)
courses.academic_requirements: UK: normally a 2:2 in any discipline. International: a 2:2 or above in marketing, communications or a business-related field, or an equivalent professional qualification, or extensive marketing experience (may require a GMAT of 550 or above and/or an interview).
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each component. Also normally Grade C GCSE English or an equivalent qualification.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: 2:2 honours or above is a 4-year BA/BSc with a minimum 2.5 GPA (scale not stated), or MA/MSc 2nd Division (minimum 62.5% after a 2-year BA/BSc). 2:1 or above is a 4-year BA/BSc with a minimum 3.0 GPA, or MA/MSc 1st Division (above 75% after a 2-year BA/BSc).
courses.notes: Placement fee of GBP 3,000 per year is shown on the course page for the placement route. Modules are not tagged by year.

courses.title: International Business Management
courses.overview: A taught master's at the Hendon campus on international business, delivered in person and via digital platforms, with a dissertation or a strategic business simulation in place of it.
highlights: Strategic Business Simulation (listed modules; compulsory or optional status not shown)
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 honours degree or above and two or more years of relevant business experience, or graduate-level professional qualifications. No interview required.
courses.english_requirements: Course page gives no scores. The general English requirements page lists, for Business and Law postgraduate programmes, IELTS 6.0 with 6.0 in reading and writing and a minimum of 5.5 in other components, and for other postgraduate courses IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each component. Which applies to this course is not stated.
courses.experience_requirements: Two or more years of relevant business experience, or graduate-level professional qualifications
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: 2:2 honours or above is a 4-year BA/BSc with a minimum 2.5 GPA (scale not stated), or MA/MSc 2nd Division (minimum 62.5% after a 2-year BA/BSc). 2:1 or above is a 4-year BA/BSc with a minimum 3.0 GPA, or MA/MSc 1st Division (above 75% after a 2-year BA/BSc).
courses.notes: English band not stated on the course page and the applicable column of the general table is unclear, so structured IELTS fields are left null. The 2026 version of the page shows a GBP 18,750 fee for January and April 2027 entry; the 2027 page shows GBP 19,800 for 2027/28.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, 4 years full-time with placement, 6 years part-time
courses.overview: An undergraduate degree combining programming, algorithms, data analysis and introductory artificial intelligence, available over three years or four years with a placement year.
highlights: Introduction to AI and Data Science
Web Applications and Databases (all listed as compulsory)
courses.academic_requirements: UK entry: 80 to 112 UCAS tariff points, A levels BB to BBC, BTEC MMP to DMM. Pakistan page: successful completion of a minimum of one year of a bachelor's degree from a recognised university with a minimum of 65% for Year 1 entry.
courses.english_requirements: Course page gives no scores. General undergraduate guidance: IELTS 6.0 with 5.5 in each component; PTE 59 with 59 in all components; TOEFL listed as overall 4 with 4 in all components (scale not clear). Pre-sessional English offered.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: minimum one year of a bachelor's degree from a recognised university with at least 65% for Year 1 entry. The page does not state an intermediate (FSc) route.
courses.notes: English scores are from the general English language requirements page, not the course page. Pakistan requirement on the country page is for Year 1 entry after one year of bachelor's study, so direct entry from intermediate is not confirmed.

scholarships.name: Regional Award for nationals of Pakistan
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 Regional Award to nationals of Pakistan
scholarships.summary: A regional award that Middlesex states it offers to nationals of Pakistan. The Pakistan page gives the amount but not the basis, deadline or application steps.
scholarships.criteria_text: Nationals of Pakistan. Further terms are not stated on the Pakistan page.
scholarships.notes: The general international scholarships page describes regional awards as around GBP 2,000 towards the first year of tuition and says to contact the International Office; amounts conflict. Application route, offer requirement and whether it is deducted from year one are not stated for Pakistan.

scholarships.name: Regional and International Merit Awards
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 2,000 towards course fees (the international scholarships page says around GBP 2,000 off first year tuition fees)
scholarships.summary: A merit-based fee reduction for international students who show strong academic results or promise in their field, across taught undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Only one Middlesex scholarship can be held at a time.
scholarships.criteria_text: Students who excel in their studies or show promise in their field, on taught undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Apply through the nearest International Office.
scholarships.notes: Entry year and offer requirement are not stated. This may be the same scheme as the Pakistan Regional Award; the pages quote different amounts.

scholarships.name: Alumni Postgraduate Award
scholarships.value_text: Reduction of up to 20% of the tuition fee, or 40% for most Arts and Creative MA courses
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for UK and international Middlesex alumni, and students in the final stages of their programmes, who continue to a postgraduate course at Middlesex. Students on partner institution courses receive 10%.
scholarships.criteria_text: Alumni and final-stage students progressing to a Middlesex postgraduate course; state this when applying. Exclusions apply.
scholarships.notes: Full terms and exclusions are on the alumni awards page, which was not opened. Entry year not stated. Digital Marketing MSc page mentions a 20% discount for Middlesex undergraduate alumni starting in January.
